text_fidelity_a:
Rosewill 3.5 Inch Hard Drive Enclosure to USB 3.0 / eSATA. External Hard Drive Case Aluminum Body, Built-in Cooling Fan and Fan Switch. Support 3.5” SATA III / II / I Hard Drive up to 6TB and UASP function. Wouldn't recognize on the eSATA port. It would detect the HDD, but would not format nor store data. I thought it would be plug and play. I submitted a return request (which the seller approved), but after extensive Googling, discovered how to make it work on my machine.

1) For Windows 7 (I think Windows 10 may not have this issue), make sure you have the registry entry to allow AHCI.
2) In BIOS, make sure your boot devices are in proper order.
3) In BIOS, update RAID configuration to AHCI.

After that, it is operating as expected.
text_fidelity_b: Rosewill 3.5 Inch Hard Drive Enclosure to USB 3.0 / eSATA. External Hard Drive Case Aluminum Body, Built-in Cooling Fan and Fan Switch. Support 3.5” SATA III / II / I Hard Drive up to 6TB and UASP function.

text_fidelity_a:
Blink Outdoor Camera Wall Mount Bracket, Hard Protective Case and Metal Mount for Blink XT2 Cameras Weather Proof Adjustable Indoor Outdoor Mount and Cover for Blink Home Security(3 Pack, Black) When I installed my Blink XT2, I found I needed to move it a little lower so I could maybe see the face of the delivery person. Thinking I could unscrew the mount without removing the camera, I turned the camera to one side so I could access the screws. The camera fell to the floor. A little bit of friction is not sufficient to hold these cameras. That is when I started looking at these mounts which SHOULD be included in the box.

This is in several parts. Plastic camera-enclosing parts are held together with 4 small screws. The metal part is attached to the wall with 3 flat-head #6 screws.

Unscrew the adjusting part so the base of the mount can be attached to the wall. Do not try to adjust the angle unless this part is loose. Use care when tightening the screws - do it manually so the screws are not over-tightened. The aluminum base could be cracked by over-tightening.

The small screws that are used to attach the back cover to the front should be machine screws, and the posts into which they are screwed should be metal. This is my opinion and is because these screws will have to be removed and reinstalled every time the batteries are replaced.

One piece of plastic had a small 'tab' on it that had to be cut off before the back cover would attach to the front.

A hole in the bottom of the plastic is there to allow a charging cable to be attached. If you do not plan to use rechargeable batteries and have no need for the USB cable, plug the hole so insects do not go inside looking for a new home. I used a small piece of closed cell foam packing material (photo).

If you want to use these mounts with the earlier Blink cameras, you might want to use some foam so the camera does not move around inside the enclosure (photo).
text_fidelity_b: Blink Outdoor Camera Wall Mount Bracket, Hard Protective Case and Metal Mount for Blink XT2 Cameras Weather Proof Adjustable Indoor Outdoor Mount and Cover for Blink Home Security(3 Pack, Black)

text_fidelity_a:
Aokeo USB Microphone, Condenser Podcast Microphone for Computer. Suitable for Recording, Gaming, Desktop, Windows, Mac, YouTube, Streaming, Discord For the price this is a very nice USB microphone, I would agree with other reviewers that it performs on par with or better than similar competing USB condenser mics in this price range such as Blue Snowball or the Behringer C1.

I do wish it came with more accessories though similar to the non-USB version. The Aokeo AK-60 XLR version comes with a scissor boom arm, shock mount and pop filter for the same price.. so if you do happen to have a compatible audio interface with phantom power then I would recommend the XLR version.

The main annoyance with this mic is that when using it in windows 10 the driver does not have native mic gain control option. In many recording programs you can boost the mic gain via other means but if using this mic for gaming or other purposes through the native drivers then you will have to be very close to the mic to produce adequate volume (ie you pretty much need a boom arm) or otherwise you will need to boost gain via external passthrough program such as APO equalizer. I have also tried this mic in linux and the drivers there do have native gain control.

Overall I do think the sound quality and construction of the mic is good for the price and I would recommend it .. just note that if using windows 10 you will probably either need a boom arm or need to use external software to boost the mic gain. A boom arm is strongly recommended anyways to prevent extraneous noises like keyboard clacking, etc..
text_fidelity_b: Aokeo USB Microphone, Condenser Podcast Microphone for Computer. Suitable for Recording, Gaming, Desktop, Windows, Mac, YouTube, Streaming, Discord

text_fidelity_a:
Ballistix Sport SODIMM 16GB Kit 8GBx2 DDR3 1600 MT/s PC3-12800 CL9 at 1.35V 204-Pin Memory BLS2C8G3N169ES4 This review is for the Crucial Ballistix Sports XT 16 Gig DIMM kit.

I was a little concerned with the DIMMs as they were a little fatter than normal, but they snapped easily into my Dell desktop computer. Both Windows 7 and Ubuntu recognized the memory at once, with no issues, which really was to be expected.

Often, I'll run multiple VMs at a time. I do software development, so often I'll have one VM running Windows Server 2008, hosting SQL Server, while a second acts as a development box, and a third, which is frequently wiped out and recreated (or really, cloned from a blank copy) acts as a testing machine. Each of these machines gets 4 gig dedicated ram, and I leave the last 4 for the host OS. This RAM has held up to that kind of intense use without any problem. I am delighted.

I also use this machine for intense gaming, and again, this RAM does an awesome job. The memory, left at default configuration, is fast, fast, fast. Again, I'm a happy user.

Overall, I think the product is an exceptional value -- a top performer at a sensible price. The best I can say is, after a while you won't notice it. It will give you solid performance with no problems, and will just become invisible as you. I will definitely be using them again next time I'm in the market for memory.
text_fidelity_b: Ballistix Sport SODIMM 16GB Kit 8GBx2 DDR3 1600 MT/s PC3-12800 CL9 at 1.35V 204-Pin Memory BLS2C8G3N169ES4

text_fidelity_a:
Solo New York Impulse 17.3 Inch Laptop Duffel, Black/Grey This is a very high quality laptop duffel bag. Because it comes in a plain, gray color and has a simple, unadorned design, either gender and all ages could use this bag. It is quite multipurpose. It could be used for travel, as a business briefcase, or even as a gym bag.

The bag has an attractive, functional design, using faux leather, canvas and nylon. The handles have comfortable, padded grips. The lining of the bag is a light, nylon material that looks moisture resistant. There are side pockets created to hold both a laptop and a tablet, and there are straps to secure them in place. There is a side pocket on the outside of the bag with two smaller inner pockets.

This bag comes with a 5-year limited warranty.

My only objection is that many may find it rather expensive for what it offers.

All in all, this bag is attractive, functional, comfortable to use and a safe way to carry a laptop or tablet.

I rate this bag as follows:
Efficiency and effectiveness of design: 5 stars
Attractiveness: 5 stars
Value for cost: 3 stars
Overall: 4 stars
text_fidelity_b: Solo New York Impulse 17.3 Inch Laptop Duffel, Black/Grey
